g.title: methodology
g.text: (phased, checkpoint-gated development; each phase validated on a real phone; findings feed back to design)

g.title: start
g.text: PS2 comms blackout + PS5 information fog

g.title: lit
g.text: DTN epidemic routing · PRoPHET · BLE mesh survey
Bluetooth-5 PHY measurements · barometric floor level

g.title: gap
g.text: silence is discarded · needs user action ·

g.title: req
g.text: native Kotlin · 31-byte packet contract · transport = interface
no network calls · no crypto library · minSdk 26

g.title: des
g.text: Dead Man's Packet · battery to PHY ladder · three role UIs

g.title: h0
g.text: H0 Capability probe on 3 phones (PHY flags)

g.title: h1
g.text: H1 Packet codec + 10 test vectors (pure Kotlin)

g.title: h2
g.text: H2 Advertiser + scanner — 1M and Coded PHY

g.title: h3
g.text: H3 Store + relay — content-addressed, dedup, hop++

g.title: h4
g.text: H4 Dead Man's Packet — SilenceEvaluator (the USP)

g.title: h7
g.text: H7 Simulator — 500 nodes, Rasuwagadhi toll curve

g.title: val
g.text: airplane mode · tests T1 to T8

g.title: hard
g.text: persistence · real GPS + incident origin · immobility to TRAPPED
responder key · RESOLVE · ALERT · Sybil guards

g.title: ci
g.text: 87 JVM unit tests on every push
